# Relay

Public application: https://relay.alx21.chatgpt.site
Source and usage: https://github.com/agammann/relay-webmcp

Relay is a browser-bound, server-stored project workspace for human tasks, structured agent assignments, dependencies, clarification questions, deliverables, and review.

Create a project and tasks in the UI. Six page-side WebMCP tools read context, list ready work, claim a task, record progress, request input, and submit a deliverable. Context includes answered questions and review feedback. All task operations are also available in the browser UI.

Relay does not launch agents or execute external work. Profiles are assignment labels, not authenticated accounts. The browser cookie selects a workspace; JSON export/import supports backups and transfer. There is no account recovery or team link sharing. Approval is a workflow step, not separate human-role authentication.
